title: Procurement of Main light spares, Solar Charger Controller, Stepper Motor & Controller for various Lighthouses under Goa Directorate.
summary: GeM bid item specification document for buying metal halide lamps and ballasts, stepper motors and controller drives, connectors, PTFE wire and an MPPT solar charge controller for lighthouses under the Goa Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Near GMC Stadium, Bambolim, Goa

scope.item: Metal Halide Lamp, double end, 230V/150W, cool white
Metal Halide Ballast 230V/150W suitable for Sl. No. I, warranty 2 years
Metal Halide Lamp, double end, 230V/70W, cool white
Metal Halide Lamp, single end, 230V/70W, cool white
Metal Halide Ballast 230V/70W suitable for Sl. No. 2 and 3, warranty 2 years
Stepper Motor, torque 10 kg-cm, as per sample of existing motor
Stepper Motor, torque 45 kg-cm, as per sample of existing motor
Spare male/female connectors compatible with stepper motors and controllers (Sl. VI-VII, IX-X)
Motor controller drive unit for 45 kg-cm stepper motor
Motor controller drive unit for 10 kg-cm stepper motor
Teflon coated (PTFE) copper wire 2 sqmm for connecting MH lamps to ballasts
MPPT Solar Charge Controller 40A, 12/24V, 5V USB port, large LCD, warranty 2 years

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any Nationalized Bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa, payable at Goa (amount not printed); eligible MSME bidders may submit Bid Securing Declaration (Form 1) instead.

period.warranty: 2 years for MH ballasts and MPPT controller; 3 years for stepper motors and controller drives

eligibility: Self-attested experience certificate for relevant electrical works/supply
Original EMD or Bid Securing Declaration (MSME)
Technical details/brochures of items proposed; point-by-point compliance with specifications, deviations to be raised only in pre-bid meeting
specs: Stepper motor 10 kg-cm: 2.8A bipolar 4-wire, shaft dia 6mm, frame 56x56mm, height 75mm, min 3m cable with connector, 3 yr warranty
Stepper motor 45 kg-cm: 6A bipolar 4-wire, shaft dia 12mm, frame 86x86mm, height 95mm, min 3m cable with connector, 3 yr warranty

Controller drive units: 230V AC and 12V DC input, overvoltage/overcurrent/short-circuit protection, enable/direction/start-stop toggles, lockable speed pot with 4-digit RPM meter, enclosed with fans, 3m motor cable
Items must match existing systems; bidders advised to visit Aguada Lighthouse, North Goa
